text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! This summer, I'm gonna chase down 
that sun! And catch it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to become strong and 
mighty like the sun! I'll do whatever it 
takes!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's push hard and give it 
everything!
Yeah, let's push hard all the way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! If it's to get stronger, I 
don't mind getting boiled in a bubbling 
pot♪

Yes, pursuing strength is an Umamusume's 
instinct.

Every Umamusume runs striving to be the 
strongest. Undaunted by whatever trials 
may come.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I've won a few GⅠs. But... it's not 
enough. Not yet—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
To satisfy this craving, I need even 
greater strength. And eventually—with Big 
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I don't like it. Acting like I don't 
even exist, that kind of attitude.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, I'll get strong enough to make you 
look my way. No matter what it takes!

"I want to get stronger, I want to win, no 
matter what it takes." But such feelings 
can sometimes... lead one to run wild.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, I can't lose! I absolutely cannot 
lose. If it's to win, then~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: UGRAAAAH, *CHOMP*!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Shinko Windy just tried to bite 
another Umamusume~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, her legs gave way, 
finishing in 2nd place! She's in 2nd 
place! What a shocking turn of events...!

The mischievous Umamusume with a biting 
habit, Shinko Windy. Her antics became a 
hot topic as a bizarre midsummer 
occurrence.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Trudging toward us from over 
there is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
..................Biko. ......You too? You 
of all people?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even you, who plays with me all the time, 
are gonna treat Windy-chan like a joke and 
laugh at me?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I-I wouldn't laugh! Windy-senpai always 
takes such good care of me, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why did you try to bite during the 
race?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But Windy-chan just really, really 
wanted to win, na no da...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that, and before I knew it... I 
went straight in for a bite..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... But still, chewing on it during 
a race doesn't feel like a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because it'd hurt if I got bitten, and 
wouldn't trying to bite back get me 
disqualified...?
choice_data_list:
It doesn't always result in 
disqualification, huh.

It doesn't always result in 
disqualification, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, why?

I explain. As long as the interference 
doesn't affect the finishing order, it 
won't result in a disqualification or 
demotion.

Since it was only an attempted bite, and 
the Umamusume who was nearly bitten 
crossed the finish line in 1st place, no 
disciplinary action was taken this time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for what I did, but... no matter 
what it takes, the desire to win just 
wells up inside me, you know...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but that just feels... kind of wrong. 
Wanting to win no matter what it takes, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think so too, Biko? Is it a bad 
thing to want to win no matter what?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's... I mean, I want to win 
too, but going too far isn't good...

Biko Pegasus hesitated, unable to come up 
with words to properly convince them...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Allow me to answer that question!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oho, Bakushin O-senpai!

The one who arrived was Sakura Bakushin O, 
the king of sprint races respected by all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Biko-san, Windy-san. We 
Umamusume are 'strong,' but at the same 
time――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: We must be "role models"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Model? Windy-chan too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Even if you want to do as you 
please, you must never become someone you 
can't be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I race, what I always think about 
is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, allow me to take the vanguard 
again today! Follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't just wait and see if you want to 
win! Of course, making the first move 
might not suit the pace and could lead to 
defeat, but still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will be the one to challenge 
them! I will charge forward! Show my 
courage! And occasionally self-destruct!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Unless I am that kind of presence, I 
cannot write 'Class Rep' on my forehead. 
That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O... Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy doesn't really get it, but it's 
cool, nodda~. Even Windy-chan can tell 
what looks cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! As long as you understand that 
much, that's plenty. Let's stay pure and 
righteous. Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Being strong is important. But 
that's not all there is to it, is it.”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Come to think of it, Carrotman had 
a similar episode. Episode 15: "A Carrot 
Heart That Never Breaks Even If Snapped!"

text_block_list.name: Stiff-Shoulder Monster Kachikochin
text_block_list.text:
"Why, Carrotman!? Why did you challenge me 
to a fight, knowing you would lose?"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat is victory! Everyone must have 
learned how to fight by watching my 
defeat!"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Follow me, everyone! There is nothing to 
fear. Defeat is when fear steals your will 
to challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Angry People
text_block_list.text: "Uooooooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"That story didn't feel quite 
satisfying... I wanted Carrotman to defeat 
them at the end, not everyone together. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's a hero too, huh. It's not just 
about raw strength...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Carrotman! I didn't 
understand it at all! Now I feel like I 
can watch Episode 15 with a totally new 
perspective!

Sakura Bakushin O's way of thinking seemed 
to challenge Biko Pegasus's values. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, Windy-senpai! If I wanna become 
like Bakushin O-senpai, I can't stay the 
way I am now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Let's train together and hone our courage 
even more! Let's join hands on this!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you really are simple. But if you 
insist, I guess I'll keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Windy-senpai and I always play 
together by splitting into the hero and 
monster roles.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Could we do some special training like 
that?

Hero vs. Monster. If we were to design 
some training around that premise...
choice_data_list: Protect the city from the monster!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a contest of strength?! I won't lose 
at that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Toh! Giant Carrotman is here! Prepare 
yourself, Munch-Munch Monster!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Rawrr! The Nom-Nom Monster is born from 
deep within the earth~. I'm gonna push ya 
over~.

text_block_list.name: Biko & Windy
text_block_list.text: Torya!
And so, their white-knuckle grapple began.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, just a little more! Just a little 
more and I can take 'em down...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I'm in a pinch, I am~ I'm 
starting to feel like biting something, I 
am~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no fair! That's cheating, 
Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A chance! While their guard is down!

A back-and-forth battle ensued. Thanks to 
their heated seaside clash, both of their 
lower bodies got an incredible workout.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Protect the city, huh...? Then Windy-chan 
will be the monster that comes ashore and 
goes on a rampage!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Well then, that's it for me—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat the kaiju! I'll do my best until 
we chase it all the way back into Tokyo 
Bay!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Raaaaawrrr, raaaaawrrr!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't let them advance any further! Hang 
in there, Defense Force! Fire, fireeee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh~, I can still take it~. I won't 
lose~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai is really working hard... 
Alright, in that case, I'll block the way!

The grueling war of attrition dragged on. 
Both the attacker and the defender seemed 
to have honed their grit.
